## Topics {.theme-content}

1. The SEEA Central Framework.
2. Physical energy flow accounts (PEFA).
3. Air emissions accounts (AEA).
4. Data available in Tunisia.

## The SEEA Central Framework

The System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA) records flows between the environment and the economy in supply and use tables consistent with the System of National Accounts [@seea2014].

- PEFA describe energy flows in terajoules [@seeaenergy2019].
- AEA attribute emissions to resident industries and households [@eurostat2015aea].
